description: Warehouse forklift agent modeled on Section 2.3: reaches the middle shelf and carries heavy items. These are scenario capabilities, not a claim of implemented forklift hardware control. Limits: Middle-shelf retrieval and heavy-item transport; no top-shelf or flight capability is advertised. Capability does not grant access: protected resources require a valid, unrevoked permission for the authorized task interval.
name: Forklift Agent

skills.name: Reach middle shelf
skills.description: Model the physical capability to reach a middle-shelf storage location for retrieval. Access to protected items requires valid authorization.
examples: Retrieve an authorized target item from the middle shelf.

skills.name: Carry heavy items
skills.description: Model transport of heavy items in the warehouse scenario. No numerical payload limit is specified; actual execution depends on an appropriate hardware implementation and valid access permission.
examples: Carry an authorized heavy target item retrieved from the middle shelf.
